prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.5 °C (69% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.7 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.3 °C (59% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.84 s (within 1% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.56 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 360 W·min/l (6% below healthy). No internal bypassing detected; volumetric efficiency is optimal.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.4 bar (3% below healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
